regulation_clause.text: Closure requests must be honoured within 7 working days (subject to dues); failure incurs a penalty of Rs 500 per calendar day of delay until closure, provided no outstanding.

gold.gold_rationale: T6CL03 subtracts non-working days from elapsed days before subtracting the 7-day SLA (lines 20-27), so WS-ACCRUAL-DAYS is a working-day-equivalent count, then multiplies by 500. This implements working_day accrual, not the clause 19 calendar_day requirement.
